meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 帮你把消息渠道(如 Telegram、WhatsApp)连到指定的 agent 分组，决定共享还是会话隔离，也能新增渠道组、调整已有接线、只读查看当前配置。
howto.when: 当你刚添加了某个消息渠道、处于初始搭建阶段，或想重新配置渠道与 agent 分组的接线时，可以让 Claude 操作。

say.text: 帮我把 Telegram 群接到 my-agent 文件夹
say.note: 会先问隔离选项再执行注册

say.text: 查一下当前有哪些渠道还没接线
say.note: 会列出已接线/未接线/未配置三类

say.text: 把某个 Slack 频道改接到另一个 agent 组
say.note: 需提供频道 ID 和目标分组

howto.what_en: Claude can connect messaging channels (Telegram, WhatsApp, etc.) to agent groups, set shared/isolated sessions, add channel groups, change wirings, and show read-only config.
howto.when_en: After adding a channel, during initial setup, or whenever you want to reconfigure channel-to-agent-group wirings.

say_en.text: Wire this Telegram group to the my-agent folder.
say_en.note: It will ask about isolation first.

say_en.text: Show which channels are not wired yet.
Move this Slack channel to another agent group.
say_en.note: Provide channel ID and target group.
